BiblicalUsage: Meshuwbah is apostasy, backsliding, the turning away of a people who knew better. Hosea 11:7 says God's people are bent to backsliding from Him, and Jeremiah 2:19 says their backslidings shall reprove them, for it is an evil thing and bitter to have forsaken the LORD. Proverbs 1:32 warns that the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and Hosea 14:4 promises the healing: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe backsliding is a bending, not a single fall: a people leaning away until they cannot stand straight. My position is that the promise is greater than the bending, because the God who names the sin also promises to heal it freely.
